final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, p.product_color, AVG(ili.product_quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / ili.derived_total_cost) AS average_cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY average_quantity DESC) AS quantity_rank FROM grouped) SELECT order_item_id, product_color, average_quantity, average_cost_ratio, quantity_rank FROM ranked WHERE quantity_rank <= 3
